ev.q: this investigation identified approximately 1,000 contacts who required follow-up
CDC identified 22 contacts from the flight, involving seven U.S. states and two countries
COSD HHSA identified 483 community contacts, 81 of whom received self-quarantine recommendations because they lacked presumptive evidence of immunity.
Isolates from all five patients (A–E) were genotyped as D8 with an identical corresponding nucleotide sequence
This travel-associated measles outbreak serves to remind travelers, airlines, clinicians, and the public
